summary: A plain-text detector finds links, dates, street addresses and phone numbers as byte ranges. There are no email, flight, money or tracking detectors, no typed match values, and no pasteboard detection.

features.feature: Match base type and string scanning
features.note: returns kind plus byte range only; no typed payload per match
http, https and www; used for tappable links in Notes via springboard/src/shell/textarea.rs
range only, 7 to 15 digits; no parsed number value
street plus house number, English and Icelandic; no components (city, postcode)
only yyyy-mm-dd and d.m.yyyy; no times, ranges or relative dates
